autopilot.title: Bisect autopilot
autopilot.intro: Describe the problem. The AI writes a test script; you check it, then it runs commit by commit in a temporary worktree next to the repository. Your working directory stays as it is.
autopilot.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Fahrenheit values are too low since last week
autopilot.testCommandHint: A command that shows the problem, e.g. npm test
autopilot.scriptHint: Exit 0 = good, 1–127 except 125 = bad, 125 = skip. It runs on your computer, in the temporary worktree.
autopilot.scriptTooLong: The script is longer than 64 KiB.
autopilot.stepTimeoutHint: A step over the limit counts as skipped.

autopilot.onlySkipped_other: Only skipped commits are left – the first bad commit is among {{count}} candidates
autopilot.timedOut_one: {{count}} step skipped after the time limit
